                            grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            objects.append((color, cells))

    by_color = {}
    for color, cells in objects:
        by_color.setdefault(color, []).append(cells)

    # Arrange color pairs in side-by-side columns, ordered by their

    colors = sorted(by_color, key=lambda col: min(c for obj in by_color[col] for _, c in obj))

        upper_max_c = max(c for _, c in upper)

        upper_height = upper_max_r - upper_min_r + 1
        lower_top = h - lower_height
        upper_bottom = lower_top - 2
